uncertain_points.claim: Enum st_logical_e is 3 bits wide but defines only 6 states, leaving two encodings (3'b110, 3'b111) undefined. If the FSM logic does not explicitly handle these unused encodings, a radiation-induced bit-flip or logic glitch could cause the FSM to enter an illegal state.
uncertain_points.cond: When st_logical_e type variable takes a value outside the enumerated set due to a fault.
uncertain_points.risk: The FSM may hang in an illegal state or transition unpredictably, possibly bypassing error detection in the KMAC error checker and corrupting subsequent processing.
